violations.reason: An automated review verdict approves a non-existent PR (PR #0) with an empty critical reason, acting as a pipeline stage faking success.
Coverage audit report falsely claims zero gaps despite missing core client requirements for the Moodle LMS integration (SSO, role sync, access control, and fallback).
The core requirement from the Client Brief to fix HTTP 401 errors for authenticated requests is entirely unaddressed by the current codebase and merged PRs.
The parsed JWT claims are unwired to the persistence layer. The API's authorization logic parses the JWT but fails to verify the user in the database, dropping the underlying authorization check.
The PR claims to verify access control but only modifies the mocked JWT payload without updating the underlying authorization logic, failing to trace or fix the real cause of the 401 errors.
